title: emc2 common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the other emc2 schemas. Data model 1.9.0 (PDA), see model/README.md.

uuid.description: UUID in lowercase canonical form. Generated by whoever creates the entity, never reused.

timestamp.description: Point in time, RFC 3339 in UTC with a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-10-03T08:15:30.250Z.

pluginId.description: Plugin identifier: lowercase letters and digits, words separated by single hyphens. Also used as the plugin's extension namespace. Data model 1.9.0 (CR-0048 point 3): emc2 is reserved, for the SDK's own service keys (emc2.*).

fieldName.description: Data model 1.2.0. A declared field's name (ADR-0038): a top-level key in its plugin's namespace, extensions.<plugin-id>.<name>.

typeName.description: Namespaced type name '<namespace>.<name>'. The namespace is 'core' or a plugin id.

version.description: Entity version. 1 when created, increased by one by the object store with every change.

actor.description: Who caused something: always a plugin, plus the user and/or external system when known. The user is set by the server from the login session, never trusted from the client.

meta.description: Set by the object store. Clients never send it.

externalRef.description: Copied from the create request's externalRef (model rule 16); kept unchanged for the entity's life.
Identity of an object in an external system, so repeated updates from that system modify the same object (e.g. a CoT uid). Unique per system and id among existing objects (model rule 16).

dataSource.description: Where an object came from (ADR-0023): 'manual' for objects users draw, otherwise the name of the incoming stream as configured in the receiving plugin, e.g. 'tak-north'. Lowercase words separated by single hyphens. Fixed when the object is created (model rule 14).

extensions.description: Plugin-specific data, keyed by plugin id. Each value is opaque to everyone but the owning plugin and is forwarded untouched by all others (ADR-0007).
